scenes.title: Palm muting
scenes.subtitle: Chunky rock rhythm.
lines: This lesson teaches chunky rock rhythm using palm mutting.
We'll focus on power chords and how to mute the strings with the palm of your hand.

scenes.heading: Palm muting
lines: Rest the edge of your strumming hand lightly on the strings where they meet the bridge.
This gives a chunky, percussive sound.
If your hand drifts toward the neck, the notes die.
If it sits too far back, nothing is muted.
Let's try a simple palm-muting pattern.
Strum eight eighth-note downstrokes, two per beat, keeping time with the metronome.
Let's try a simple rock rhythm.
Strum each chord with eight even downstrokes, matching the metronome.
The pattern lights up as it plays — just follow the beats.
Let that muted sound sit in your hand.
Play along — the app is listening, ready to help you find the balance.
